entries.title: Psalms 108:7
segments: The providential dealings of God in enlarging a people, call for devout acknowledgment and thanksgiving.

entries.title: Psalms 108:11
segments: Prosperity and adversity are both the servants of God.  They go and come at his bidding, and accomplish his infinitely wise and benevolent designs.
